title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode2 A Lonely Street

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'm staying behind to practice with Miku some more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks, Ichi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't work too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See you at school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, see you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for making you stay, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, don't worry about that. There's something you want to talk about, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong? You can talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
How can I become more confident?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More confident?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've definitely gotten much better at singing lately thanks to all the help I've been getting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you have improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But it still feels like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Someone else told me that it could be a matter of having confidence in myself, but I don't know how to feel more confident...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I'm asking you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My mind is telling me to just keep practicing, but I feel like there's more to it than just that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
You've been doing very well in practice too, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you still feel like something is missing, it may help to actually sing in front of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like in public...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some people practice their hearts out and even sound great, but can't quite produce the same results when it matters most.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By singing and playing in front of people, you'll naturally become more and more confident in your abilities.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You may be right. We haven't actually played in front of anyone yet, have we...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But where or when can we do that...?
The School Festival is too far off and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then how about a street performance?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're bound to receive a confidence boost by learning to sing in front of complete strangers, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, there's usually someone performing on Main Street too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But can I do what they do...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure you can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I'm a little nervous, but I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I'm glad I asked you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'll be rooting for you.
The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this a good spot...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's no one performing here today for a change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get nervous. What should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, I'll be fine...
Just sing the way you do during practice and remember what Kusanagi taught you.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku's cheering me on too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Okay, be brave...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(W-Wait...
Something's wrong. One more time. Just breathe...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My voice... I can't sing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I'm usually much louder than this.
What's happening...?!)

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student
rows.Line: Wait, seriously? That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Male High School Student
rows.Line: Hahaha. And my teacher got so mad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Right, they're all within earshot of my voice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But what if I start getting weird looks? What if they start laughing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I almost feel too scared of playing my guitar too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to get better. I need to keep singing...)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Hey, remember that place we had lunch at the other day?

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! That place was so good! We have to go again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Ah, thank you so much for calling me back! Oh, yes! It's about that...!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: R-Really?! Thank you very much! I'm looking forward to doing more business with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're not even laughing, let alone listening...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No one cares about my music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should stop for today...
